reviewed_by: Codex, working-knowledge and Assistant browser contract review
reason: Retire application-model GUI without data loss; project-scoped legacy links open Assistant. Make managed browser an observable, read-only viewer while retaining pause/resume, protected resources, approvals and existing assistant tool capabilities. Reviewed and collected 29 Core, 54 frontend, 24 browser conversation/context/approval UI cases, plus 16 real-Core knowledge/viewer cases on eight permanent profiles. Input rejection, model tool access, project isolation, reconnect and accessibility are the affected boundaries.
exclusions: No full suites, scans, external-site interactions, existing session continuation, live-data clearing or tool replay. Graph editing/reset/fullscreen GUI tests are retired with that removed feature; backend graph/reset contracts are not removed. New real-Core browser selection runs separately with Xvfb and a disposable local fixture. No new desktop package, live update or physical-device acceptance is requested/performed; changed native acceptance scripts require a future package run. No Rust implementation change.

supplemental_local_playwright.reason: Real Core with production LAN UI, fixed local fixture; no target supplied by clients, no scans. New knowledge survives retired links/reload; read-only image, HTTP and WS rejection, reconnect, unchanged page, pause/resume and axe. Distinct from compiled/installed package acceptance.
